title: OKF Wiki
short_description: Full OKF wiki ecosystem — build wikis from source datasets (wiki-builder skill), browse/edit/search/visualize them (okf-wiki app), curated by a dedicated wiki-curator agent profile.
long_description:
OKF Wiki pack gives you everything you need to create, maintain, and explore Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2 knowledge bundles:

**wiki-builder skill** — 8 deterministic CLI tools for generating wikis from source code, documentation, or any document collection. Tools: okf-list, okf-bundle, okf-update, okf-import, okf-index, okf-validate, okf-concepts, okf-crosslink.

**okf-wiki app** — A full web UI for browsing wiki bundles, editing concept pages (frontmatter + body), searching across concepts, viewing backlinks, exploring the knowledge graph, validation, templates, import/export.

**wiki-curator agent profile** — An agent that combines the skill and app awareness. Can build wikis from sources, validate them, enrich with LLM-generated descriptions and cross-links, and browse the results.

All components read/write the same ~/wiki/ directory — build a bundle with the CLI tools, then browse it instantly in the web app.
author: Omnideck
